## Assigning a palette that will be re-used throughout the clustering
```{r}
palette <- c("Labyrinth progenitors" = "#C77C00",
              "JZ progenitors" = "#E69500",
             "CTB" = "#A86500",
             "SynT I" = "#0A3D85",
              "SynT II" = "#0C63B8",
             "Fusing CTB" = "#1977D2",
             "STB" = "#062E66",
             "STB (rabbit)" = "#08418F",
             "STB (guinea pig)" = "#1456B0",
             "GlyT" = "#D993B9",
              "SpA-TGC (mouse)" = "#9C4F85",
             "Invasive trophoblast (rat)" = "#B76AA3",
             "Invasive trophoblast (rabbit)" = "#C982B8",
             "Invasive trophoblast (guinea pig)" = "#A1427C",
             "Column CTB" = "#E3A9C8",
             "EVT" = "#7A3A65",
              "SpT" = "#0B525B",
             "S-TGC" = "#4FB3BF",
             "P-TGC (precursors)" = "#1D7874")
```
## Mouse Atlas
```{r}
Atlas <- readRDS("../ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Trophoblast/MouseTrophoblastAtlas_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.rds")

## Extracting trophoblasts and renaming to match the palette
Atlas@meta.data$cell.type.final <- Atlas@meta.data %>%
  mutate(cell.type.final = case_when(cell.type.short %in% c("SpT", "precSpT") ~ "SpT",
                                     cell.type.short == "precPTGC" ~ "P-TGC (precursors)",
                                     cell.type.short == "LaTP" ~ "Labyrinth progenitors",
                                     cell.type.short %in% c("precSynTI", "SynTI") ~ "SynT I",
                                     cell.type.short == "JZTP" ~ "JZ progenitors",
                                     cell.type.short %in% c("precSTGC", "STGC") ~ "S-TGC",
                                     cell.type.short %in% c("precSynTII", "SynTII") ~ "SynT II",
                                     cell.type.short == "SpATGC" ~ "SpA-TGC (mouse)", .default = cell.type.short)) %>%
  pull(cell.type.final)

## Assigning identity
Idents(Atlas) <- "cell.type.final"
p1 <- DimPlot(Atlas, cols = palette) + NoLegend() + theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/TrophoblastAtlas_Mouse_UMAP.png", plot = p1, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/TrophoblastAtlas_Mouse_UMAP.pdf", plot = p1, width = 6, height = 4)

## Clear up
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("palette")))
```
## Rat Atlas
```{r}
Atlas <- readRDS("../ReferenceFiles/Atlases/Trophoblast/RatTrophoblastAtlas_FinalVersion_26thMay2026.rds")

## Extracting trophoblasts and renaming to match the palette
Atlas@meta.data$cell.type.final <- Atlas@meta.data %>%
  mutate(cell.type.final = case_when(cell.type.short == "precPTGC" ~ "P-TGC (precursors)",
                                     cell.type.short == "LaTP" ~ "Labyrinth progenitors",
                                     cell.type.short %in% c("SynTI", "precSynTI") ~ "SynT I",
                                     cell.type.short == "JZTP" ~ "JZ progenitors",
                                     cell.type.short %in% c("precSTGC", "STGC") ~ "S-TGC",
                                     cell.type.short %in% c("SynTII") ~ "SynT II",
                                     cell.type.short== "InvTroph" ~ "Invasive trophoblast (rat)",
                                     .default = cell.type.short)) %>%
  pull(cell.type.final)

## Assigning identity
Idents(Atlas) <- "cell.type.final"
p1 <- DimPlot(Atlas, cols = palette) + NoLegend() + theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/TrophoblastAtlas_Rat_UMAP.png", plot = p1, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(filename = "Visuals/TrophoblastAtlas_Rat_UMAP.pdf", plot = p1, width = 6, height = 4)

## Clear up
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("palette")))
```

## Create a legend for the plots above
```{r}
legend_data <- data.frame(cell_type = names(palette), color = palette)
rownames(legend_data) <- NULL
legend_data$category <- c(rep("Progenitors", 3), rep("Multinucleated", 6), rep("Migratory", 7), rep("Other", 3))
legend_data$y <- c(10:8, 6:1, 10:4, 2:0)
legend_data$x <- c(rep(-0.3,9), rep(1,10))
legend_data

## Dummy plot
p_legend <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = cell_type), size = 5) +  # colored box
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_type), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.2, size = 4) + # cell type labels
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(legend_data$color, legend_data$cell_type)) +
  # Add category headers as text (we place them manually)
  geom_text(
    data = subset(legend_data, !duplicated(category)),
    aes(x = x - 0.2, y = y + 1, label = category),
    hjust = -1, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 5
  ) +
  xlim(-0.5, 2.25) +   # space for labels
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# Save figure
ggsave("Visuals/TrophoblastAtlases_UMAP_Legend.png", plot = p_legend, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
